status: experimental; end-to-end performance provisional under competing host workloads

methodology.comparison: One Q8 Metal target loaded per process, DFlash enabled. Only shared-mask/direct-RoPE policy toggles. Alternating adjacent pair order; second session starts optimized and reverses recording order. First study repeated once because of uncontrolled CPU-heavy host work. Eight processes total.
methodology.timing: External synchronized resident seconds include request cleanup and exclude model loading, file reading and policy switches. Headline statistics, if cited, use median adjacent pair reduction rather than ratios of pooled medians.
methodology.limitations: Separate-checkout Swift compilation and Node workers were observed. Untouched stages drifted substantially; neither series establishes idle-system latency. Do not combine these absolute timings with prior qualification timings or advertise a robust peak-throughput improvement.
methodology.operators: Python MLX 0.32.4, 35 samples per variant, alternating order after warmup. Isolated captured operators, not full inference. Capture files store tensor values contiguously.
methodology.profiles: Debug forced-barrier diagnostics; sequential profiles used different builds. Barriers alter overlap and add overhead. Component/layer times cannot be added to release latency or credited wholesale to these changes.
methodology.accuracy: Two English fixtures only. Exact frozen token parity on 160 measured sequences and eight recorded first inferences; remaining warmups excluded. Recognition quality beyond these fixtures is not qualified.
methodology.validation: 39 focused tests, two real-checkpoint profile tests, release build, scoped strict SwiftLint and git diff --check passed. Full repository gate deferred by user.
